description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller class 'HelloController' that provides basic API endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message for the application.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI for API documentation, preserving request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check returning 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information including project name.
